definitions.explanation: writing done by hand rather than typed or printed; also refers to the quality or style of someone's handwriting

examples.japanese: {手書|てが}きの{手紙|てがみ}をもらった。
この{書類|しょるい}は{手書|てが}きで{記入|きにゅう}してください。
examples.english: Please fill out this document by hand.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}の{手書|てが}きの{年賀状|ねんがじょう}は{毎年|まいとし}{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: I look forward to her handwritten New Year's cards every year.

notes:
FORMATION:
{手|て} (hand) + {書|か}き (writing) → written by hand

USAGE PATTERNS:
- {手書|てが}きの + noun: handwritten [noun]
- {手書|てが}きで{書|か}く (to write by hand)
- {手書|てが}き{入力|にゅうりょく} (handwriting input/recognition)

CULTURAL NOTE:
In Japan, handwritten correspondence is considered more personal and sincere than typed text. {手書|てが}き is valued especially for formal occasions like {年賀状|ねんがじょう} (New Year's cards) and {礼状|れいじょう} (thank-you letters).

RELATED:
- {筆跡|ひっせき} (handwriting style/penmanship)
- {達筆|たっぴつ} (beautiful handwriting)
- {悪筆|あくひつ} (poor handwriting)
